page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e3.7xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.e3 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on a KVM hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.e3.7xlarge offers a high-density memory profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads. It is designed for applications requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources, such as medium-sized in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
